    def test_download_own_note(self):
        answer = call(self.store, "token-ann", "GET", f"/notes/{self.mine.id}/download")
        self.assertEqual(answer.status, 200)
        self.assertEqual(answer.headers["Content-Type"], "text/plain; charset=utf-8")
        self.assertEqual(answer.headers["Content-Disposition"], f'attachment; filename="note-{self.mine.id}.txt"')
        self.assertEqual(answer.body, "Shopping\n\nmilk, eggs\n")

    def test_download_needs_a_session_and_a_note(self):
        self.assertEqual(call(self.store, None, "GET", f"/notes/{self.mine.id}/download").status, 401)
        self.assertEqual(call(self.store, "token-ann", "GET", "/notes/999/download").status, 404)
        self.assertEqual(call(self.store, "token-ann", "POST", f"/notes/{self.mine.id}/download").status, 405)
